name: voxel-app
description: Android wrapper for the VOXEL LED screen control panel.

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android && npm run clean:appledouble
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
